description: Quét target (module/hệ thống ERP/website) và tạo module map, feature inventory, JSON metadata, gap report. v2.0: Final release sau 8 sprints (~17.5h actual / 27.5h estimated). Sprint 1 compliance core (Protocol 14/15/16/18, POST-GATE T1-T4), Sprint 2 resume + checkpoint per layer, Sprint 3 lazy-load 11 procedure files (~75% context saving per phase), Sprint 4 bash scripts delegation 7 scripts (~85% token saving Phase 1-2), Sprint 5 cross-skill integration target-map.json v2 schema + 3 consumer skills OPTIONAL --from-scan flag, Sprint 6 multi-dev safety (atomic write + cross-host lock + JSONL append + .gitignore cache + cache hit logic TTL 24h), Sprint 7 profile + delta scan (4 profiles quick/standard/deep/exhaustive ADAPTIVE 5/25/50/100 + hard cap 200, --since=<git-ref> delta filter A/M/R, argument validation Q11, URL depth max=2 Q13, exhaustive LPM 15 validators + 20-30 features + similarity 0.5), Sprint 8 evals 5→12 cases + final audit + release notes. Backward-compat 100% từ v1.0 — tất cả CLI args mới đều OPTIONAL. v1.7: Sprint 7 profile + delta scan — 4 profiles (quick/standard/deep/exhaustive) với adaptive max-pages 5/25/50/100 (Q4=D), --max-pages override hard cap 200, --since=<git-ref> delta scan (filter A/M/R changed files, skip D), argument validation hardening (Q11 — enum/numeric/git ref/conflict detection), URL depth limit max-depth=2 hardcoded (Q13 — root + 1 level, không recursive crawl), exhaustive profile LPM extensions (deep business rules MAX 15 validators thay vì 5, key_features target 20-30 thay vì 10-20 + coverage validation, gap match similarity threshold 0.5 thay vì 0.6 + fuzzy notes), delta scan defensive cache skip (DELTA_MODE → skip Phase 1.5 lookup + Phase 5.5g write). v1.6: Sprint 6 multi-dev safety — atomic write hardening (safe_write_json + append_jsonl helpers), lock lifecycle hardening (cross-host detection + trap EXIT), _shared/scans-index.jsonl + _shared/history.jsonl population (git-sync friendly JSONL append), .gitignore cache + lock entries (Q2 = A — per-machine cache vì fingerprint chứa absolute path), cache hit logic TTL 24h + --no-cache bypass flag, concurrency model documented (3 test scenarios trong _shared.md). v1.5: Sprint 5 cross-skill integration — target-map.json v2 schema (scan_fingerprint, previous_scans, scan_diff, traceability, module_code_mapping, consumer_hints), POST-GATE T2 thêm v2 fields check, OPTIONAL --from-scan flag cho 3 consumer skills (wf-add-scope, wf-define-features, wf-design). Backward-compat: $schema chuyển từ target-map-v1 → target-map-v2; consumers detect via $schema value. v1.4: Sprint 4 bash scripts delegation — Phase 1-2 enumeration delegate sang 7 bash scripts (~88% token saving), Phase 3 split developer (3.1 code-derived) + business-analyst (3.2 tiếng Việt) per Q3 decision.

scripts._notes: Sprint 4 bash delegation. common.sh provides atomic_write_json/json_escape/slugify/lock helpers. fingerprint.sh = Q6 composite hash. detect+inventory+api+ui+db = Phase 1-2 enumeration. URL crawl + agent prompts vẫn AI.

inputs.description: Path đến source code local hoặc URL cần scan
Tên module cụ thể cần focus (auto-detect nếu không cung cấp)
Path đến spec/feature file để so sánh và tạo gap report
Tiếp tục session in_progress/paused gần nhất (GAP-05 — Sprint 2)
Hiển thị status các sessions (table 5 latest), KHÔNG scan → STOP (GAP-05 — Sprint 2)
Resume session ID cụ thể (chỉ dùng cùng --resume)
Bypass cache lookup ở Phase 1.5 (force fresh scan). KHÔNG ghi cache mới khi POST-GATE pass (Sprint 6 multi-dev safety — Q2 = A)

Sprint 7 — Profile system. Map sang scan_depth + MAX_PAGES (URL crawl page cap): quick (shallow, 5) | standard (deep, 25 — default) | deep (deep, 50) | exhaustive (deep + LPM extensions, 100). CLI flags --depth/--max-pages override profile defaults. exhaustive bật LPM: MAX 15 validators (thay vì 5), key_features target 20-30 (thay vì 10-20), gap similarity 0.5 (thay vì 0.6) + fuzzy notes.
Sprint 7 — Override profile default MAX_PAGES cho URL crawl. Hard cap 200 (Q4 ADAPTIVE — vượt 200 phải chạy nhiều sessions với scope filter, tránh DDoS target). Validation enforce ở Phase 0.1b.

Sprint 7 — Delta scan. Compute changed files giữa <git-ref>..HEAD bằng `git diff --name-status --find-renames=80`, filter A/M/R (skip D). Phase 2 L1-L4 restrict scope chỉ trên changed files. Yêu cầu target=local-source trong git repo. Validation Phase 0.2b. Defensive: cache lookup + write đều skip khi delta mode active (cache full scan, delta = subset → mismatch).
